summary: iter189 consolidated test of 7 bugs + 2 features. Bug 2 (Quick Bid black screen) VERIFIED FIXED — exactly 1 Radix Dialog open at a time across the Quick Bid → Review Total Cost → Confirm Your Bid sequence (EN tested live; FR locale loads with 'Enchère rapide' buttons). Bug 1 (responsiveness) VERIFIED — 1024/1280/1366/1440px × 5 routes (/, /marketplace, /auth, /storage-auctions, /vehicle-auctions) all show scrollWidth==clientWidth, zero horizontal overflow. Bug 3 (default filter state) — GET /api/marketplace/items (no params) returns 200 with {items:[…]} list shape, default state untouched. Bug 4 (PUT /users/me) VERIFIED via live API: name/phone/province update returns 200 and persists (GET /auth/me confirms). Bug 5 (axios 401 interceptor) — backend /api/auth/refresh endpoint verified working (200 with new access_token; bogus token rejected); frontend code review confirms axios.interceptors.response.use is registered at module load in /app/frontend/src/contexts/AuthContext.js lines 22-89 (queue, /auth/refresh exempt list, bidvex:auth:logout custom event all present). Live runtime injection test was inconclusive because window.axios is not exposed for in-page eval and fetch bypasses the interceptor — code path is correct but recommend a manual Storybook/DevTools trigger to fully exercise the live retry+queue. Bug 6/7 — frontend code paths confirmed (showPromoModal + deposit-section render guards present in detail pages). Feature 1 + 2 — POST /api/payments/promote-listing accepts ALL six listing_types (marketplace, lots, storage, vehicle, partner, multi_item) and rejects bogus types/tiers with 400; whitelist exercised live. Feature 2 frontend — all 4 promote-button data-testids present in the codebase: promote-listing-btn (ListingDetailPage line 589), promote-lots-btn (MultiItemListingDetailPage line 555), boost-storage-auction-btn (StorageAuctionDetail line 138), promote-vehicle-btn (VehicleDetailPage line 786). 14/14 backend pytest tests PASS.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/components/FlattenedMarketplace.js lines 216-233 — handleQuickBidSubmit now closes Quick Bid first then schedules BidConfirmation via setTimeout(0). Confirmed live: only 1 [role=dialog][data-state=open] node at any time during the flow.

/app/frontend/src/contexts/AuthContext.js lines 22-89 — interceptor at module scope. Queue logic (_pendingQueue, _flushQueue) correctly serialises concurrent 401s. /auth/(refresh|login|register|logout|google) regex exempt — prevents recursion on the refresh call itself. CustomEvent 'bidvex:auth:logout' dispatched on refresh failure → main App can clear state. Token-expired detection accepts both 'token_expired' string and empty-detail 401 (matches iter180 bilingual-error shape).

/app/backend/routes/payments_promotions.py line 107 — listing_type whitelist now includes all 6 types (marketplace, lots, storage, partner, vehicle, multi_item). _listing_collection() at line 62 routes vehicle→db.vehicle_listings, lots/multi_item/partner→db.multi_item_listings, storage→db.storage_auctions. Confirmed live via parametrized 6-way test — all return 404 (not 400) on missing listing, proving listing_type validator passes.

Frontend promote buttons — all 4 confirmed in source with correct data-testid: promote-listing-btn, promote-lots-btn, boost-storage-auction-btn, promote-vehicle-btn. Vehicle button is correctly conditional on owner+!is_promoted regardless of vehicle_auctions_enabled feature flag (the backend accepts listing_type='vehicle' independently).
